Adapted from c-testsuite [tests/single-exec/00169.c](https://github.com/c-testsuite/c-testsuite/blob/5c7275656d751de0e68b2d340a95b5681858ed07/tests/single-exec/00169.c), whose pinned [.otags](https://github.com/c-testsuite/c-testsuite/blob/5c7275656d751de0e68b2d340a95b5681858ed07/tests/single-exec/00169.c.otags) identify TinyCC `tests/tests2/16_nesting.c` at commit `61ba9f229955f105af9d7dcdbfcc9c9effbe8af3`. The upstream [README](https://github.com/mirror/tinycc/blob/61ba9f229955f105af9d7dcdbfcc9c9effbe8af3/README) specifies GNU LGPL and [COPYING](https://github.com/mirror/tinycc/blob/61ba9f229955f105af9d7dcdbfcc9c9effbe8af3/COPYING) supplies LGPL v2.1; the adapted code retains that license, with a copy at [LICENSE.tinycc](../LICENSE.tinycc), not c-testsuite's top-level MIT license. The original three nested loops are extracted into grid_count with bounded dimension parameters; counting replaces printing each coordinate tuple. The mutation starts the innermost coordinate at one instead of zero, omitting one depth layer. The main function and eight-input reference driver were added for this corpus; this is a source-derived reduction, not a claim to replay the complete original test.
